title: Senate to look into impeachment prosecutors' 'wacky' shots at session hall
summary: Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian is investigating alleged "wacky" photos that prosecutors in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte apparently took inside the Senate Session Hall.
